About Pisgah Solutions

Pisgah Solutions Pvt Ltd is a premier provider of comprehensive security, manpower, and facility management solutions in India. Built on a foundation of operational excellence, strict statutory compliance, and rigorous workforce selection, Pisgah Solutions delivers customized protection and management frameworks designed to enable businesses and residential communities to operate safely and seamlessly.

Our Mission

To deliver exceptional, high-quality security and facility services at competitive prices with strong ethics and corporate social responsibility. We empower clients to focus on core operations with complete peace of mind through heavy investment in workforce selection, support, continuous training, and leading-edge technology.

Our Vision

To become the most preferred manpower and security services provider across India by setting benchmark service levels. We aim to deploy the right skills at the right place and right time, cultivating a safe, vibrant, and cooperative environment where client assets are safeguarded and individuals prosper.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do you verify your security personnel?⌄
Every guard undergoes rigorous police verification, official address checks, and complete background clearance before deployment.
What is your response time for emergencies?⌄
Our rapid response mobile teams are on constant standby, with dedicated patrol units for swift emergency intervention and instant site backup.
Do you provide training for your staff?⌄
Yes, all personnel go through our rigorous training academy covering security protocols, fire safety, emergency response, first aid, and soft skills.
Can I customize the services?⌄
Absolutely. We design tailored post orders, guard duties, and service plans based on a full site audit of your property.
What areas do you serve?⌄
We serve residential communities, corporate & IT parks, retail malls, healthcare facilities, warehouses, and educational institutions across India.
